recognize_zh: BCL2 染色整片小淋巴球呈陽性，大結節內可見多個邊界不清、淡染的 BCL2 陰性區塊（被套層細胞打散的生發中心），右上方小濾泡的生發中心亦為陰性，表示生發中心沒有異常表現 BCL2。
features: Diffuse BCL2 positivity in small lymphocytes of mantle zones and interfollicular regions
Numerous ill-defined pale BCL2-negative patches within the large nodule (disrupted germinal center fragments)
Small follicle at the upper right with a round BCL2-negative germinal center
Capsule and fibrous tissue at the right edge; cleft artifact across the nodule
Low contrast staining makes nodule boundaries difficult to define
describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse staining of small lymphocytes throughout the node, with multiple ill-defined BCL2-negative pale zones within the large nodule corresponding to disrupted germinal center remnants. A small adjacent follicle also has a BCL2-negative germinal center. There are no BCL2-positive neoplastic follicles, although the low staining contrast limits detailed assessment. Findings support a reactive process consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: In follicular lymphoma the CD10-positive follicle center cells co-express BCL2, whereas here the germinal center areas are BCL2-negative.
BCL2 staining of background small cells is similar in both; NLPHL is recognized by BCL2-negative LP cells with surrounding PD-1+ T cells.
